title: The review record doc and the review_state docstring say what the code reads after item 471 a
why: After #2252 merges, the doc and the docstring will state a rule the code does not enforce, so a lane that reads them owes a round the guard never asks for.
note: Record step (coordinator 08:20 CST Nov 10). Blocked until #2252 (review-state-guard-needs-round-3, home of item 471 a) merges. After that, docs/decisions/pr-review-record.md line 62 and the review_state docstring still say a delete-only guard change with a failed round 1 owes round 3, but the code reads done after a passing round 2. Line 52 lacks the fix-check exception. A record lane.
